items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Johnny Browns, only to the subsequent mention of Bob Lyons' cousin.

ctx.x: Oh, Bob Lyons' cousin. That's the best.

Oh, we had a whole lot of musicians around here. We had a follow-up, he used to play... Johnny Browns? Johnny Browns would play violin. And he played clarinet after? Yeah. And you don't remember Stanley, do you? He used to play trombone for him?
Well, he used to talk about Joe Johnson.
